descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**MBG:VR — Build, mine, craft, and survive together in VR.** 🛠️

# Overview
Step into **MBG:VR**, an imagination‑fueled sandbox where every world is yours to bend. Shape insane builds with tactile VR tools, dig for rare resources, and craft gear that changes how you play. Nights get dangerous—fortify, trap, and fight to keep your home standing. There are no rules: create wild builds, pull off daring strategies, and write your own stories.

# Features
- **Build & Fortify** — Design bases, towers, and traps with hands‑on controls.  
- **Mine & Craft** — Harvest materials and upgrade your kit. ⛏️  
- **Dungeons & Loot** — Raid hidden caverns for rare rewards.  
- **PVP & PVE** — Team up or duel; face AI bosses or other players. ⚔️  
- **Farming & Animals** — Grow crops, raise livestock, sustain your crew. 🐄  
- **No rules, all imagination** — Make chaos beautiful and play your way.

**Personalize your avatar with skins, grab your crew, and build something unforgettable.**
